questions.question: At the pool of Bethesda, what did Jesus tell the man who had been an invalid for thirty-eight years?

answers.text: Get up and pick up your mat and walk
Go and wash in the pool of Siloam
Go and show yourself to the priests

questions.question: When the Jews began to persecute Jesus for healing on the Sabbath, how did Jesus answer them?

answers.text: My Father is working and so am I
The Sabbath was made for man
I came to fulfill the Law

questions.question: Jesus said the Son gives life to whom He wishes, just as the Father raises the dead. True or false?
Jesus told the Jews who did not believe Him that He would not accuse them before the Father. Who is their accuser?
